about: The season's generated pages: story_split.draw (planner, author, aids) on a captured story_context() of a learner jumped to a gap day of season 1, at A1, A2 or B1. Contexts live in sets/pages/<id>.json (test_capture_pages.py). Scored on the story judge's questions (app/services/season/story_judge.py) from 1 to 5; this surface is the writer-model comparison of the Phase 2 decision.
